quality.review_scope: Selected operational PbSe synthesis and isolation alternatives, two three-layer device architectures, graphene analytical preparations and source-linked characterization from all five main and five SI pages. Exact batches, graphene manufacture and unreported settings remain unresolved; no complete-paper Reader.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch identifiers, reagent grades, measured atomic coordinates and unreported operation settings remain unknown.
Every omitted numeric value stays unreported; listed characterization settings belong only to their named analytical context.
conflicts: Mainp2 compares QD-bottom with QD-bottom in its layer-uniformity sentence; the duplicated device label is retained as a source typo without selecting an intended replacement.
Abstract gives responsivity~10^6A/W whereas introduction says up to10^5A/W for both types. Preserve plots and differing scopes, not a reconciled single maximum.
Figure 3 G-bottom plotted legend includes 18 V while its caption lists 0, ±3, ±6, ±9, ±12, ±15 V; keep the source graph/caption conflict. Main p3 uses B-bottom once; no third architecture inferred.
Mainp4 βvalues0.02 and−0.1 coexist with prose describing G-bottom as high β; numeric source fit values retained without theoretical correction.
